capabilities: Show Material Design icons for files and folders in the file explorer
Match icons by exact filename, longest extension, and folder name
Map custom extensions to any icon via a searchable picker
Toggle file and folder icons independently
disambiguation: Not a full appearance theme; it only swaps the icons shown next to files and folders in the file explorer.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Icon artwork is drawn from Material Design Icons and Material Symbols via the material-icon-theme npm package.
intentEvidence: Material Design file & folder icons for the Obsidian file explorer
problem: The file explorer shows generic file and folder icons, making it hard to tell file types apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: Icon artwork comes from Material Icon Theme, consumed through the material-icon-theme npm package

summary: Icon pack that applies Material Design icons to file and folder names in the file explorer, matched by filename, extension and folder name.
